label: Orders
caption: MAYORKAS, SEC. OF HOMELAND, ET AL. V. INNOVATION LAW LAB, ET AL.
text: The motion to vacate the judgment is granted. The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit with instructions to direct the District Court to vacate as moot the April 8, 2019 order granting a preliminary injunction. See United States v. Munsingwear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950). The motion to intervene is dismissed as moot.
